evidence_scope: wireframe screenshot supplied by user on 2026-09-12

source_authorities.name: Apple Accessibility — Differentiate Without Color Alone
Apple Accessibility — Reduced Motion evaluation criteria

contracts.project_interpretation: Top controls and composer must use environment safe-area insets; screenshot dimensions are not substitutes for runtime constraints.
contracts.expected_result: No functional control or critical content is obscured by system UI or hardware regions.
contracts.evidence: Screenshot visually shows clearance from status/home regions, but no code/runtime constraint evidence was provided.
contracts.remediation: Inspect implementation constraints and test on target iPhone/iPad configurations.

contracts.rule: Layout must adapt to available space and must not depend on a fixed device width.
contracts.project_interpretation: Use adaptive layout, not coordinates copied from the screenshot.
contracts.expected_result: Stable layout across supported size classes, orientation, window resizing and text-size changes.
contracts.remediation: Audit layout primitives and remove device-specific hardcoded widths.

contracts.rule: Essential content must not be clipped at accessibility text sizes.
contracts.project_interpretation: Chat/Work labels, suggestions and composer must reflow/expand rather than truncate critical content.
contracts.expected_result: No essential clipping at supported accessibility text sizes.
contracts.remediation: Test supported content-size categories and document results.

contracts.rule: Interactive controls use adequate hit areas; project baseline on iOS is 44×44 pt when applicable.
contracts.project_interpretation: Visual icon size may be smaller than the hit area.
contracts.expected_result: Each applicable target meets or exceeds the project baseline.
contracts.evidence: Screenshot pixels cannot be converted reliably into platform points.
contracts.remediation: Measure hit frames in implementation and automated UI/accessibility inspection.

contracts.rule: Icon-only interactive controls expose meaningful accessibility labels.
contracts.project_interpretation: Every icon-only button must expose role, label and state where relevant.
contracts.expected_result: VoiceOver announces action and state unambiguously.
contracts.evidence: No accessibility tree or VoiceOver test supplied.
contracts.remediation: Add/verify semantic labels and run VoiceOver journey test.

contracts.rule: Controls expose normal, active/pressed, disabled and relevant async states.
contracts.project_interpretation: Voice/live additionally requires perceptible active/listening state.
contracts.expected_result: Required states are visually and semantically distinguishable.
contracts.evidence: SPEC lists interaction states, but implementation evidence is absent.
contracts.remediation: Create state matrix and validate component previews/runtime.

contracts.rule: Dynamic Type is supported where applicable.
contracts.project_interpretation: Text must adapt at system text-size changes and containers must grow/reflow.
contracts.expected_result: Text scales without essential truncation or overlap.
contracts.evidence: No implementation or text-size test supplied.
contracts.remediation: Use semantic text styles/tokens and test accessibility categories.

contracts.rule: Support light and dark appearances where applicable.
contracts.project_interpretation: Screenshot is evidence only for the supplied light appearance.
contracts.expected_result: Both supported appearances preserve hierarchy and contrast.
contracts.evidence: Light appearance screenshot supplied; dark appearance absent.
contracts.remediation: Provide dark-mode implementation and screenshot/runtime test.

contracts.rule: Color is not the sole means of communicating state.
contracts.project_interpretation: Selection and voice/error states need redundant shape/text/icon/semantic state.
contracts.expected_result: State remains understandable without hue differences.
contracts.evidence: Selected Chat segment has a distinct filled capsule, but assistive selected-state semantics are not evidenced.
contracts.remediation: Verify selected trait/state and grayscale legibility.

contracts.rule: Prefer native/platform-standard controls before fully custom controls.
contracts.project_interpretation: Visual styling may be branded while preserving familiar platform behavior.
contracts.expected_result: Native primitives are used or deviation is explicitly justified.
contracts.remediation: Inventory primitives and record custom-control justifications.

contracts.rule: Current selection must be perceptible visually and by assistive technology.
contracts.project_interpretation: Chat/Work mode must expose selected state in semantics, not only visual styling.
contracts.expected_result: Selected mode is visually obvious and announced as selected.
contracts.evidence: Visual selection is present; semantic selection state is unknown.
contracts.remediation: Verify platform segmented-control semantics or add selected trait/state.

contracts.rule: VoiceOver identifies relevant controls, labels, values and states.
contracts.project_interpretation: Critical chat journey must be operable without sight.
contracts.expected_result: All common tasks are discoverable and operable with meaningful announcements.
contracts.remediation: Run scripted VoiceOver journey from mode switch through compose/send/tool/voice states.

contracts.project_interpretation: Focus should follow logical reading/action order and not jump unpredictably between chrome and composer.
contracts.remediation: Test VoiceOver and keyboard focus order.

contracts.rule: Motion respects Reduce Motion when nonessential.
contracts.project_interpretation: Streaming/tool/voice feedback must remain understandable with reduced motion.
contracts.expected_result: Problematic motion is removed/reduced or replaced while preserving meaning.
contracts.remediation: Add reduced-motion variants and test with system setting enabled.

contracts.rule: Labels must support longer localized strings without fixed-width assumptions.
contracts.project_interpretation: The centered mode switch may need expansion/reflow for longer localized labels.
contracts.evidence: Only English labels are shown in the supplied screenshot.

contracts.rule: RTL is supported when target locales require it.
contracts.project_interpretation: Use leading/trailing semantics and mirror directional symbols when appropriate.
contracts.expected_result: Reading order and directional UI adapt correctly.
contracts.evidence: Target locale set and RTL runtime evidence are A DEFINIR.
contracts.remediation: Define locale scope and test RTL if applicable.

contracts.rule: Perceptible asynchronous operations communicate progress, completion or failure.
contracts.project_interpretation: The state list in SPEC-CHAT-AGENT-001 is necessary but must be implemented and tested.
contracts.expected_result: Async states have observable and accessible feedback.
contracts.evidence: SPEC declares SENDING, STREAMING, TOOL_RUNNING, TOOL_RESULT, ERROR_RETRYABLE and VOICE_ACTIVE; no runtime evidence.
contracts.remediation: Implement and test state transitions including error/retry.

contracts.rule: Increase Contrast is validated when applicable.
contracts.project_interpretation: Low-contrast gray secondary text and light surfaces require explicit validation.
contracts.expected_result: Controls and text remain distinguishable with increased contrast settings.
contracts.remediation: Test Increase Contrast and update semantic tokens if needed.

contracts.rule: Keyboard, pointer and focus behavior are validated where the target platform requires them.
contracts.project_interpretation: The supplied tablet-like wireframe makes keyboard/pointer behavior relevant unless platform scope excludes it.
contracts.expected_result: All primary controls can be focused/activated and focus is visible.
contracts.evidence: Platform target and runtime test are A DEFINIR.
contracts.remediation: Confirm platform scope and run external keyboard/pointer tests where applicable.
